description: Free instant Agent-Ready check of any public website, answers in German. Two scores: Grundlagen 0-100 (can ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google find, read and understand the site today: HTTPS, robots.txt for AI crawlers, Schema.org, readable without JavaScript, sitemap, llms.txt, title/description/contact, speed, bot protection) and Zukunft 0-100 plus level 0-5 (Cloudflare agent-readiness scan, isitagentready.com). Returns gaps, top tips and a result page link. Takes up to 60 seconds. Required: url.
